reason: No trade beats holding here. A ~90/10 hold is effectively priced in, so this book, being long-only unleveraged dividend-aristocrat equities rather than duration-sensitive bonds or leveraged rate bets, has no edge to harvest from repositioning ahead of a well-telegraphed outcome, and any surprise cut/hold swing is a small, symmetric macro risk that a rebalance can't safely front-run. (3) Book-level picture: +3.51% vs SPY +2.37% since 2026-07-17, max drawdown only -2.74%, and the defensive-staples-plus-energy-hedge structure is doing its job (CVX +15.08% offsetting MO/PG weakness) -- the strategy of record is working as designed after only two months, so a full replacement would burn real basis points (2bps/side equities, plus SEC/TAF on sells) to chase noise rather than a thesis-level change. Holding preserves the working structure through the FOMC print and lets the aristocrat/king dividend growth engine keep compounding.
